title: 低资源编程语言与AI负载共同重塑云原生工程
english: OpenAI reports work to improve ChatGPT for low-resource programming languages, supported by new evaluations covering software engineering, SQLite, and COBOL migration. Separately, the CNCF describes AI workloads as reshaping Kubernetes autoscaling. Its summary highlights an existing division of labor in which the scheduler places pods on nodes while separate control loops have historically had limited interaction. Together, these topics point to a changing operations landscape: engineering assistants must support more diverse legacy and low-resource language environments, while platform teams need to examine how workload characteristics affect Kubernetes control behavior. The supplied sources do not provide implementation details or performance results, so operational conclusions should remain limited to these stated directions.
chinese: OpenAI正在提升ChatGPT对低资源编程语言的支持，并新增覆盖软件工程、SQLite和COBOL迁移的评测。与此同时，CNCF指出，AI工作负载正在重塑Kubernetes自动扩缩容；其摘要强调，Kubernetes传统上由调度器负责将Pod放置到节点，并由彼此较少交互的控制循环分工运行。两项信息共同表明，平台工程需要同时面对遗留语言迁移、多语言代码支持，以及AI负载对集群调度和扩缩容行为带来的影响。来源未给出具体实现、版本或性能数据。
why_it_matters: 对云原生与AIOps团队而言，AI工作负载使Kubernetes控制面中的调度与扩缩容关系更值得观测和验证；对Agent Infra而言，低资源语言、SQLite和COBOL迁移评测意味着编码代理的适用范围正在延伸到更多异构与遗留系统。资深运维开发应将评测覆盖、工作负载特征和控制循环行为纳入平台治理与职业能力建设。
interview_expression: I would evaluate AI coding support against the languages and migration paths used in our estate, rather than assuming broad capability from a general claim. For Kubernetes AI workloads, I would inspect how scheduling and autoscaling control loops interact under our workload characteristics.
